newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso ends higher ahead of holidays.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso ends higher ahead of holidays.

text.p: * Peso closes at 26.284 to dollar vs Tuesday's 26.297
The Philippine peso closed firmer on Thursday at 26.284 to the dollar from Tuesday's 26.297 because of the long New Year's weekend, traders said.
"We want to be liquid over the weekend. We sold our dollars to have more pesos," one trader said. Instead of borrowing expensive pesos, banks would rather lighten dollar holdings, others said.
Financial markets will be closed for three days next week. Bankers were expecting heavy withdrawals during the period.
The peso opened at 26.295, and strengthened to as high as 26.282 by mid-afternoon. However, the Central Bank intervened and started buying dollars to keep the peso from rising too much.
The peso was aided by the recovering health of President Fidel Ramos, another trader said.
The Central Bank adjusted its buying rate throughout the day from 26.285 to 26.282.
The parallel rate also rebounded to 26.303 from the initial 26.320, following the movement in the official market.
The local currency is seen strengthening further on Friday on arbitrage play. - RAMONCITO DELA CRUZ 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
